title: The Harrowing
subtitle: Pandemonium Fortress · Plains of Despair · Chaos Sanctuary

questions.prompt: What is the Act IV town called?
questions.explanation: Pandemonium Fortress is the last outpost of Heaven at the gates of Hell.

questions.prompt: Izual, the fallen angel, is hunted across which area?
questions.explanation: Izual wanders the Plains of Despair as part of the Fallen Angel quest.

questions.prompt: Diablo is fought at the end of which Act IV area?
questions.explanation: The Chaos Sanctuary holds the five seals that summon Diablo.

questions.prompt: What reward does Tyrael grant for defeating Izual?
questions.explanation: Tyrael grants a remarkable two skill points for freeing Izual's soul.

questions.prompt: What was Izual before his corruption?
questions.explanation: Izual was Tyrael's most trusted lieutenant until he was captured by the Prime Evils and twisted.
Diablo is the Lord of Terror, the middle brother of the Prime Evils.

questions.prompt: Who is the archangel that grants Izual's reward at Pandemonium Fortress?
questions.explanation: Tyrael, guardian of the soulstones, waits at Pandemonium Fortress and rewards Izual's release.

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT one of the Assassin's three skill trees?
questions.explanation: Warcries is a Barbarian tree. The Assassin's are Martial Arts, Traps, and Shadow Disciplines.

questions.prompt: What does Izual confess after his defeat?
choices: That his betrayal was not entirely forced
That the Worldstone is already shattered
That Baal still lives in Tal Rasha's tomb
questions.explanation: Izual's dying confession admits his corruption ran deeper than captivity; he gave up Heaven's secrets willingly in part.

questions.prompt: Which two classes were added in Lord of Destruction (the Act V expansion)?
questions.explanation: The Lord of Destruction expansion introduced the Assassin and the Druid alongside Act V.

questions.prompt: Which Prime Evil opens Act IV's gates by fleeing toward Hell?
questions.explanation: Diablo, the Lord of Terror, escapes through Mephisto's portal at the end of Act III, drawing the heroes into Act IV's hellscape.
